message.content:
An editorial illustration features a grid of twelve rectangular panels. At the top, the word "TEMPO" is centered in large white capital letters. Above it, black text reads "SALING SIKUT PABRIK GULA / SIAPA BERMAIN DI REKLAMASI MAKASSAR". The grid displays several composite images.

A central panel shows a close-up of Benjamin Franklin’s face from a United States one-hundred-dollar bill. Other panels show portions of currency, gold bars, a large stone building with a jet flying overhead, a truck on a rural road lined with trees, and a yellow mining haul truck. One panel contains a green circular seal with an eye motif and the text "FINCEN FILES".

Prominent white text reads "JEJARING GELAP FULUS GLOBAL". Below, a paragraph in Indonesian describes a collaborative report. The bottom-left panel includes a barcode, a QR code, the date "21-27 SEPTEMBER 2020", and the price "RP 45.000". Other text includes "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" and "FRANKLIN". The background uses a muted color palette of greens, yellows, and reds.
